Councilmember Gray seconded the motion. AMENDED MOTION: Councilmember Wood moved to approve the consent agenda with a correction to 9.8. to change the dates on the Takedown Scheduled In Section 1.2.12 to January 2, 2034 and 12.2.13 to January 2, 2035 and adding the demolition derbg to item 13.D. Eagle Mountain 0ity Council Meeting - February 20,2024 Page I of 12 Jim Smith representing Pony Express Events expressed appreciation for the passing of the resolution recognizing the Pony Express PRCA Rodeo Events and Demolition Derbg as a part of the Pony Express Days Celebration. They appreciate the opportunity to serve and be a part of the community celebration. Councilmember Clark thanked Pony Express Events for their dedication and service and advocated for government to support residents with talent and passion in bettering the community. Councilmember Wood welcomed Pony Express Events as official members of the celebration.
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to adopt an ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, lttah, adopting an Official Zoning Map allowing staff to make edits to colors, labets, links to master development plans and master development agreements, links to Municipal Code, and to fix any Identified minor mistakes to zoning boundaries or zoning names. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Official city zoning map adopted
motions.summary: The council adopted an official zoning map for Eagle Mountain, letting staff fix colors, labels, links to development plans and code, and minor boundary or zone-name errors.
motions.impact: The map becomes the single reference for which zone your lot sits in, but adopting it does not change anyone's zoning. Staff can correct a mislabeled boundary without another council vote.
